name: accurate
pending: T-154 (the population fit); the test is #[ignore]d until the fit exists
description: the accurate design of POP-ORA-04 simulated by the simulator of specs/simulation.md instead of R: the call below, K = 200 replicates (replicates 0..199 of one call) of one seed

start_factors.source: the same factors as oracle_pop.rs sealed_start

aggregate_checks.note: asserted on the typical values (theta); recorded for Omega and xi
aggregate_checks.bias: for each typical value: |mean over replicates of the estimate - truth| <= c_bias * sd(estimates) / sqrt(K)
aggregate_checks.coverage: for each typical value: share of replicates with truth in estimate +/- c_interval * se, |share - 0.95| <= c_coverage * sqrt(0.95 * 0.05 / K)
aggregate_checks.per_replicate: deviations of each replicate are recorded by the test, never asserted
aggregate_checks.converged: a replicate whose fit is not converged is counted and reported, and excluded from the aggregates

note: the dataset of replicate k is the rows of the table `dataset` whose subject column starts with "k:" (SIM-OUT-02); per-replicate deviations are recorded and never asserted; only the aggregates are asserted, and only when aggregate_checks.asserted is true (as the sealed design says); the committed dataset file and its hash (SIM-ORA-06 i) are a card of the engine (T-159/T-154): the call is committed here before any engine commit
